scope: Nonlinear completion of exactly the existing conditional coarse positive response/coherent-sky mean, on consumed F115W rate and field observations. No new PSF family/lens fit/error inflation.
convergence_definition: Projected KKT gradient of half-objective in declared dimensionless scales <=1e-3 AND last accepted relative full-objective change <=1e-10. Bound signs checked explicitly; native ERR unchanged.
covariance_scope: UNCONSTRAINED local curvature of the specified joint target+field+declared prior likelihood. Active bounds recorded, not a truncated posterior or physical coverage claim.

moment_geometry.centroid_convention: Raw fitted center plus FULL finite-grid response moment; a declared finite-grid convention, not established physical centroid truth.

between_exposure_scatter.scope: Formal conditional correlated-centroid diagnostic only; inadequate mean/no physical validation.

baseline_relative_moment_geometry.centroid_convention: Raw fitted center plus response finite-grid moment minus the positive-base finite-grid moment, matching the delivered relative-moment convention.

between_exposure_scatter.scope: Formal conditional correlated-centroid diagnostic only; inadequate mean/no physical validation.
